content_with_prooftexts.body: 5. Although it be a great sin to contemn or neglect this ordinance,1 yet grace and salvation are not so inseparably annexed unto it, as that no person can be regenerated, or saved, without it;2 or, that all that are baptized are undoubtedly regenerated.3
content_with_prooftexts.name: Confession of Faith

prooftexts.1:
Genesis 17:14

Any uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin shall be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”

Matthew 28:19

Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

Acts 2:38

And Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

Luke 7:30

but the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the purpose of God for themselves, not having been baptized by him.)

(ESV)
prooftexts.2:
Romans 4:11

He received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. The purpose was to make him the father of all who believe without being circumcised, so that righteousness would be counted to them as well,

Acts 10:2

a devout man who feared God with all his household, gave alms generously to the people, and prayed continually to God.

Acts 10:4

And he stared at him in terror and said, “What is it, Lord?” And he said to him, “Your prayers and your alms have ascended as a memorial before God.

Acts 10:22

And they said, “Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, who is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and to hear what you have to say.”

Acts 10:31

and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard and your alms have been remembered before God.

Acts 10:45

And the believers from among the circumcised who had come with Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out even on the Gentiles.

Acts 10:47

“Can anyone withhold water for baptizing these people, who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have?” (ESV)
prooftexts.3:
Acts 8:13

Even Simon himself believed, and after being baptized he continued with Philip. And seeing signs and great miracles performed, he was amazed.

Acts 8:23

For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity.” (ESV)

Confession of Faith

Chapter 28: Of Baptism

5. Although it be a great sin to contemn or neglect this ordinance,1 yet grace and salvation are not so inseparably annexed unto it, as that no person can be regenerated, or saved, without it;2 or, that all that are baptized are undoubtedly regenerated.3

  1. Genesis 17:14

    Any uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin shall be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.”

    Matthew 28:19

    Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

    Acts 2:38

    And Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

    Luke 7:30

    but the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the purpose of God for themselves, not having been baptized by him.)

    (ESV)

  2. Romans 4:11

    He received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. The purpose was to make him the father of all who believe without being circumcised, so that righteousness would be counted to them as well,

    Acts 10:2

    a devout man who feared God with all his household, gave alms generously to the people, and prayed continually to God.

    Acts 10:4

    And he stared at him in terror and said, “What is it, Lord?” And he said to him, “Your prayers and your alms have ascended as a memorial before God.

    Acts 10:22

    And they said, “Cornelius, a centurion, an upright and God-fearing man, who is well spoken of by the whole Jewish nation, was directed by a holy angel to send for you to come to his house and to hear what you have to say.”

    Acts 10:31

    and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer has been heard and your alms have been remembered before God.

    Acts 10:45

    And the believers from among the circumcised who had come with Peter were amazed, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was poured out even on the Gentiles.

    Acts 10:47

    “Can anyone withhold water for baptizing these people, who have received the Holy Spirit just as we have?” (ESV)

  3. Acts 8:13

    Even Simon himself believed, and after being baptized he continued with Philip. And seeing signs and great miracles performed, he was amazed.

    Acts 8:23

    For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bond of iniquity.” (ESV)
